shots.audio_direction: Dialogue forward; low industrial hum.

shots.visual_action: Reveal A/B/C holographic structures and establish their spatial positions for all later coverage.

shots.visual_action: Show the three regions as separate, apparently ordinary records.

shots.visual_action: Visualize each subsystem's 50/50 zero-one marginal without implying causation.

shots.visual_action: Make the six absent combinations understandable, then let Kevin's joke and Khaled's response land.

shots.visual_action: Let the word correlated land; preserve the pause; decide whether the screenplay's second title card remains.

shots.visual_action: Kevin notes information and geometry change together; Khaled rejects a general causal claim.

shots.visual_action: Khaled explains they need independent control without destroying raw observations.
shots.audio_direction: Tension shifts from chaos to purposeful rhythm.

shots.visual_action: Isolate shared clock, then communications route; signal persists after both; protect long pause after third operation.

shots.visual_action: Kevin reacts; Khaled says they stop assuming they know the answer; Moon says it cannot be separated.

shots.visual_action: Preserve raw observations, restore original partition and disable autonomous feedback layer.

shots.visual_action: Regions separate, geometry returns toward baseline, Moon voice fades and ORBIT confirms feedback disabled.
shots.audio_direction: Release cue then silence; no victory music.
